assets.name: wheat-ground

toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished hand-painted raster art for a warm, colourful mobile farming game. Match the inspected farm-a style: softly painted golden crops and warm rich earth, rounded readable forms, subtle brushwork, clean premium farm-game detail, no black outlines, no photographic noise, no photorealism, no plastic product render. Light comes from the LOWER LEFT (southwest); tiny form-shadows go UPPER RIGHT. Image top is north, right is east. Absolutely no text, lettering, grid, UI, frame, watermark, buildings, animals, tools or large objects. This is ONE production asset, not a sheet of variants. Genuine transparent RGBA background; no white background and no painted checkerboard.
Primary request: a square top-down orthographic ground decal beneath a wheat field, 1024 x 1024 composition. Flat earth viewed EXACTLY from overhead, no perspective and no raised block. Warm tawny brown loose soil with abundant fine golden cut stubble, arranged in many soft parallel rows running VERTICALLY from north to south. The field covers 9.5 by 10 game units. No standing wheat heads: standing wheat will be separate cards. Fill most of the square with quiet evenly distributed soil and chopped golden stems; irregular softly feathered alpha at the outer perimeter, modest transparent margin, no hard rectangle, no grassy frame. Keep the inner area solid and coherent with subtle painted furrow depth, lit lower-left, no big cast shadows.
